name: Payment Investigation Case
definition: Set of activities performed to handle an exception to a normal payment transaction flow, such as: - a payment has not been received. - a payment has been received but is incorrect. - a payment must be corrected or cancelled (requested by the party which ordered the payment).

MissingCoverIndication.name: Missing Cover Indication
MissingCoverIndication.definition: Indicates whether or not the claim is related to a missing cover.

IncorrectInformationReason.name: Incorrect Information Reason
IncorrectInformationReason.definition: Indicates, in a coded form, the incorrect information.

CaseType.name: Case Type
CaseType.definition: Specifies the type of investigation case.

PaymentStatus.name: Payment Status
PaymentStatus.definition: Status of a payment which is the reason or the result of an investigation case.

UnderlyingPayment.name: Underlying Payment
UnderlyingPayment.definition: Identifies the end to end payment which is the subject of the investigation

UnderlyingInstruction.name: Underlying Instruction
UnderlyingInstruction.definition: Identifies the payment instruction under investigation.

UnderlyingCashEntry.name: Underlying Cash Entry
UnderlyingCashEntry.definition: Identifies the cash entry under investigation.
